description:
Two errors in extras/skill/SKILL.md:

- It shows `muster pane compact <focus> --then ...` for compacting yourself; for Codex the CLI refuses a focus ("/compact takes nothing to keep"). Show a focus-free Codex form.
- Its adapter check, `muster window --json | jq -r '.panes[] | select(.pane == env.MUSTER_PANE) | .adapter'`, prints nothing from a hidden helper, whose row is under `.hidden[].panes[]`. Search `(.panes[], .hidden[]?.panes[]?)`.

Related: a_2xA54AFYT. From tooling feedback a_30cbt4xpR and a_31r14hChl.
title: Muster skill: the self-compaction example gives Codex a focus, and the adapter check misses hidden panes
